facts.fact: Business in Cameroon reports that Nigerian fintech Grey, in a 7 September 2026 update, opened a corridor sending CFA francs from dollar, euro or pound balances directly to MTN Mobile Money and Orange Money wallets in Cameroon, at $1.80 a transfer and up to CFA400,000.
facts.system: Grey corridor to MTN MoMo and Orange Money
